{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''Force-user''' inhabited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] sometime between [[1002 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] during the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="Ruusan note">According to ''[[Echoes of the Jedi]]'', the Force-user was present during at least one battle of the [[Ruusan campaign]], which was fought between [[1002 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] per ''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''.</ref> Despite the individual's [[Force-sensitive/Legends|attunement]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], their ability to [[Force power/Legends|wield]] its power was deemed unremarkable for their time. Nonetheless, the [[Force Adept|Force-user]] was present at some stage of the [[Ruusan campaign]],<ref name="EOTJ">{{DoD|Echoes of the Jedi}}</ref> a series of battles fought between the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] and a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] faction called the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

During their time on Ruusan, the Force-user encountered [[Darth Rivan]], a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] who had been unwittingly [[Time travel/Legends|transported forward through time]] and left completely [[Sever Force/Legends|severed from the Force]]. This incident occurred due to the malevolent power of the [[Darkstaff]],<ref name="EOTJ" /> a [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] that was once in the Dark Lord's possession.<ref name="Devan">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20030619devan|text=Devan}}</ref> Upon their encounter with [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Rivan, the Force-user managed to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the severely weakened Dark Lord of the Sith.<ref name="EOTJ" />
